Non-Discrimination Statement: Among the core values of Delaware Valley University is the principle to respect all people. We live this through our commitment to ensure equal opportunity to all. Delaware Valley University does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, religion, age, genetic information, protected veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other protected classes under the law, in the administration of any of its educational programs or activities, including but not limited to admissions, financial aid, athletics and employment policies and practices, as required by Title IX of the Educational Amendments of 1972, the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, and other applicable statutes.
